technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with bullish candlestick pattern and force index confirmation, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and price below intermediate moving averages create meaningful pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: MO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying data, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 3 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior Republicans with small amounts, market fear sentiment presents contrarian opportunity, but insufficient conviction and missing news data limit bullish case.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (338.4), flat yield curve, rising USD, FOMC in 2 days, and earnings binary event in 3 days create compounded risk unsuitable for directional positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + force index cross-up show genuine short-term momentum with price near support (31.80), offering a defined risk entry if pullback holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 3 days + FOMC in 2 days + VIX crisis levels + price below all intermediate moving averages + overbought oscillators create a compounded binary event risk that overwhelms technical strength.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — weak entry given macro headwinds and earnings proximity

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (three white soldiers, force index cross-up) shows short-term strength, but earnings binary event in 3 days combined with FOMC in 2 days and VIX crisis levels create unacceptable compounded risk that negates entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 3 days will trigger volatility spike; combined with overbought oscillators and price below intermediate moving averages, downside risk significantly outweighs technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; technical and sentiment agents show weakness relative to macro and earnings risk
decision.portfolio_note: Already 21 positions in Consumer Staples sector; adding MO increases concentration risk without fundamental or institutional conviction to justify it.
